name: byebyte
description: Storage Sense for Linux — a Quick Settings pill showing free space, burn rate, and time-until-full per mount (including tmpfs quota headroom, the 'disk full while df says fine' killer), plus Findings ▸: what the written policy will clean up next, and a one-click confirm to run it now. Requires the byebyted daemon (https://github.com/asuramaya/byebyte).
